clips.title: The story
paras: The Mizjah Ruins are ancient stone remains nestled in northern Stranglethorn Vale, situated just southeast of Grom'gol Base Camp. Long abandoned by their original troll architects, the crumbling structures have been seized by the brute-strength Mosh'Ogg ogres. From this vantage, the ogres launch disruptive ambushes against passing supply caravans traveling toward the Swamp of Sorrows.

Like many of the ancient stone ruins scattered throughout Stranglethorn Vale, the Mizjah Ruins were built by the Gurubashi Empire long before modern empires rose. Today, the moss-choked arches and cracked flagstones are occupied by the Mosh'Ogg clan, primarily brute warriors and crude witch doctors. Far from keeping to their stolen perimeter, these ogres routinely raid nearby supply convoys bound for the Horde settlement of Stonard, transforming ancient history into a persistent, bloody thorn in the side of Grom'gol's commanders.
